conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍打開午餐盒，噗地彈出一根長筆畫，把牠嚇了一跳。
object: a rubber dinosaur with tiny arms and a big lunch box
morph: a lunch box bursts open and spring-loaded strokes jump out as 午
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：午餐盒裡彈出筆畫。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale buttercup background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 午 as the only text on screen, drawn in tomato red solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a squat green rubber dinosaur drags a huge lunch box, tiny arms wiggling, trying and failing to reach the latch; the first 午 is spoken as the lid rattles and the top slanted stroke of 午 pokes out. 1.7-3.4s: the box bursts open with a spring and a long vertical stroke boings up through the middle; the dino leaps back with a wide-eyed double-take; the second 午 is spoken as the crossbar settles into place. 3.4-5s: 午餐 is spoken as a toy sandwich with a smile hops out and offers itself while a sun shape gleams overhead (animated shapes only). 5-8s: hold; the dino munches the sandwich with a satisfied stomp, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "午、午、午餐" (ㄨˇ、ㄨˇ、ㄨˇ ㄘㄢ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 午 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
